FAQ

Questions, answered.

How much does an app cost?

It depends on features. Message me what you need and I'll send a fixed price — no hidden charges.

How long does it take?

A simple app or website takes 1–3 weeks. Bigger apps with admin panels take a bit longer; you get a clear timeline up front.

Will it work on both Android and iPhone?

Yes. I use Flutter, so one codebase gives you both apps.

Do you help after launch?

Yes. Bug fixes and updates are part of the deal, and I'm always reachable on WhatsApp.
